summary: Long 9,500px page for a US-facing BPO: tall photo head with a request form inside it, a market-size chart split, pain split, three feature cards, an included-services list, an orange band, a photo split, a dark quality band with badges, six reasons, FAQ and a dark contact block with offices.

sections.note: dark photo ground (a person at a desk) covering the head; left: small tag, title, two-line lead and one outlined button; right: a white request-a-consultation form card (name, email, company, service dropdown, message, consent ticks, orange submit).
pale blue band: heading and short paragraph left, a two-bar chart graphic right with a caption
heading and a paragraph, four bullet pains and a closing line left; right half is a pale panel (image or accordion rows, mostly empty when measured)
centered heading, three white cards in one row with a bold title and short paragraph (automation, implementation, support)
left a grey panel with a big white line (image placeholder); right a heading, a paragraph and a six-item bullet list of what is included, then a pill button
orange band about 240px: one statement and one white button
text with an orange link-button left, a rounded team photo right (square 530px)
dark band: heading, paragraph and four certification/ISO badges in a row, plus two small text blocks
centered heading and a line, six cards (3 by 2) with a small icon; revealed on scroll, blank until then
pale blue band: heading, six question rows in two columns
orange-accented block: left a heading with two accent words and a contact form, right a column of advantage ticks and two office cards (Vietnam, United States) with phone and email
